title: Interval-uniform offset sieve with exact Fourier windowing

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, the offset sieve of proof.md (with n = ceil(log2 N) and the parameters P1-P7 there: b = ceil(sqrt n), beta = 2^b, at most sqrt(n)+1 sieve stages, r = 800(n+1)) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability > 0.92 (hence >= 2/3). In the challenge model this same algorithm has worst-case total work T(N,s) = O(2^{16 sqrt(n)} n^9) on every execution branch, including Solovay-Kitaev gate synthesis, classical sieving, addressing, source costs and all aborted attempts. The uniform bit-length envelope is B_T(n) = 2^{16 n^{1/2}} n^9, whose growth index is exactly 1/2. All constants are absolute. This holds jointly with the two workspace bounds and the sample bound below.

For the same offset-sieve algorithm and configuration in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, worst-case peak classical workspace is S_C(N,s) = O(2^{8 sqrt(n)} n^3) bits, with n = ceil(log2 N) and an absolute constant. It includes all stored labels, sorting buffers and the stored gate-synthesis table. Its envelope B_C(n) = 2^{8 n^{1/2}} n^3 has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the stated time, quantum-workspace and sample bounds and full-secret success probability > 0.92.

For the same offset-sieve algorithm and configuration in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, worst-case peak quantum workspace is S_Q(N,s) = O(2^{8 sqrt(n)} n^2) qubits, with n = ceil(log2 N) and an absolute constant. Its envelope B_Q(n) = 2^{8 n^{1/2}} n^2 has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the stated time, classical-workspace and sample bounds and full-secret success probability > 0.92.

For the same offset-sieve algorithm and configuration in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the total number Q(N,s) of fresh DCP source copies acquired on every execution branch is at most R = 8K 2^D <= 2^59 (n+1)^4 2^{16 sqrt(n)}, hence O(2^{16 sqrt(n)} n^4). The uniform bit-length envelope B_samples(n) = 2^{16 n^{1/2}} n^4 has growth index exactly 1/2. This bound includes every discarded copy, every copy rejected by the Fourier window, and aborted runs, and holds jointly with the stated total-work and workspace bounds and unconditional full-secret success probability > 0.92.

For the same offset-sieve algorithm and configuration in proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n)=0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability > 0.92 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
